beats.care: If you live or work around Hoodi, steadier power may come at the cost of shade and greenery.
beats.what: GBA gave conditional approval to cut 321 trees at KPTCL's Hoodi substation.
beats.why: KPTCL says the transmission network needs upgrading to keep supply reliable in busy parts of the city.

cards.body: The approval from GBA is conditional, Deccan Herald reported.
cards.caption: Trees approved for felling

cards.body: This comes a day after residents across Bengaluru protested flyovers partly over tree loss.

cards.q: Power upgrade vs trees: your call?

opts: To upgrade the power transmission network
cards.q: Why does KPTCL want the trees cleared?
cards.why: KPTCL says the Hoodi substation upgrade is needed for reliable power supply.

hook: Why are *321 trees* in Hoodi set to come down?

learn.t: KPTCL says parts of the city served by this network have hit peak power capacity, so upgrades are needed.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: GBA approves felling of 321 trees for KPTCL project

tldr: The Greater Bengaluru Authority has conditionally approved felling 321 trees at the Hoodi substation for a KPTCL power upgrade.
